title: Site Preparation Days Added to a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Collection Notice
content:
Site preparation days are then added. Where the service the item was delivered on makes the water, waste or gas connections and takes the old item away, the plumbed site days are added. Where that service takes the old item away but makes no connections, the disconnect site days are added. Where neither holds, nothing is added.

The plumbed site days are 2. The disconnect site days are 1.

## What the two conditions rest on

The notice in question is the notice on which a Northbeam Returns and Restocking collection is agreed.

Both conditions rest on what the fulfilment service recorded for that item on Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment does: whether it makes the water, waste or gas connections, and whether it takes the old item away. Both parts of the first condition are required together.

| Does the delivering service make the connections? | Does it take the old item away? | Days added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | 2 |
| no | yes | 1 |
| yes | no | nothing |
| no | no | nothing |

A service that makes the connections but takes nothing away adds nothing, because the first condition requires both and the second requires the haul-away without the connections.

## Cases on hypothetical inputs

*An appliance delivered on a service that plumbs the new machine in and takes the old one away.* Both parts hold, and 2 days are added.

*An appliance delivered on a service that takes the old machine away and leaves the connections to the customer.* The haul-away holds without the connections, and 1 day is added.

*A television delivered on a service that makes no connections and takes nothing away.* Neither condition holds, and nothing is added.
